name: Databricks SQL
sku: Databricks SQL warehouses as included in the Databricks platform. Documentation reviewed on the AWS docs site.

store.warehouse.note: Described as a cloud data warehouse built on lakehouse architecture, running directly on the data lake without moving the data.

serve.query-engine.note: SQL warehouses run ANSI SQL with Delta Lake extensions, from a query editor or programmatically through a REST API.

serve.bi-viz.note: AI/BI dashboards are built in for interactive reporting, though BI is secondary to the warehouse itself.

transform.sql-transform.note: Materialised views and streaming tables support incremental SQL ETL pipelines directly in Databricks SQL.

bands.note: Query history, execution plans and performance insights are built in for tuning warehouse workloads.

presentation.tagline: Serverless SQL warehouses running directly on lakehouse tables.
